prompt: Pink bakes a giant birthday cake
title: Giant Birthday Cake
irony: Pink says yes to every call for bigger until the giant cake is too big to share, so her kindest yes needs one small no.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun fills the big house kitchen where Pink piles a giant birthday cake.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green reads the recipe aloud while Navy wishes bigger and Pink says yes to all.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lilac cites party rules as the towering batter wobbles over the pan rim.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: All sing the giant birthday cake as candles and plates parade past.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Pink stacks more layers to please all as the tall cake leans sideways fast.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Frosting slides off in a sweet avalanche as all hands catch the leaning cake.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: All sing the giant birthday cake while Gray steadies the shaking table.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Pink gathers the aunties and admits her yeses grew too big to share.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Pink says one kind no to bigger and wheels the cake out to share.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: All sing the hook as Pink turns the last line to small shared slices.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: On the street all share little cakes, the big kitchen morning come true.
